name: Send top market news alerts from AlphaAI to Discord

parameters.content:
## Send top market news alerts from AlphaAI to Discord

### How it works

1. A Schedule Trigger runs the workflow every 15 minutes.
2. An HTTP Request node fetches the trending feed from the AlphaAI news API, where every story already carries tickers, sentiment and a 1 to 10 relevance score.
3. A Code node keeps fresh stories scored 8 or higher, skips stories posted in earlier runs and builds up to 10 Discord embed cards with sentiment, confidence and likely price impact.
4. A second HTTP Request node delivers all cards to a Discord channel webhook as one message.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Create a free AlphaAI API key at alphai.io (Account, API keys).
- [ ] On the "Fetch Trending News from AlphaAI" node, add a Bearer Auth credential and paste the key without the "Bearer " prefix.
- [ ] In Discord, create a channel webhook (Channel, Edit, Integrations, Webhooks) and paste its URL into the "Post Alerts to Discord" node.
- [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Customization

Adjust the schedule interval, the relevance threshold or the number of cards per run in the Code node.

## Fetch trending market news

Runs every 15 minutes and pulls the trending feed from the AlphaAI news API, with tickers, sentiment and relevance scores already attached.

## Build alert cards

Keeps fresh stories scored 8 or higher, dedupes across runs and builds embed cards.

## Deliver to Discord

Posts all cards to a channel webhook in one message, with retries.
